cues: Three words that make all of this precise.
Differentiation: a meristematic cell matures into a permanent cell, and stops dividing.
Dedifferentiation: a permanent cell regains the power to divide.
That is how the interfascicular cambium and the cork cambium form.
Redifferentiation: the products of that new meristem mature again into permanent tissue.
